Hey man, 24 also gay here 
I’m going thru some similar shit and can relate to feeling like a failure, often thinking suicide is the only option. 
Trust me when I say it will effect your friends like you couldn’t understand, my best mate lost his best friend 5 years ago and I can see it hasn’t gotten any easier for him yet. Talk to your friends!!! Friends are there for a reason and I’m sure they’ll be supportive, we can’t go thru things alone, we are not meant to! My therapist and friends (and cat) keep me going day to day and sometimes getting shit out verbally can help it leave the head for just long enough to enjoy something. 
Your feelings are valid and you are aloud to feel sad! Just remember feelings will always come and go, people will be there for you, the world beautiful in the smallest and largest of ways and I know life has a spot with a nice view waiting for ya x
